subject: HOF Gen7 privacy provenance: migration/readiness lacks content authorization; secure-bearing capture materialized before discard
body: Completed the bounded Gen7 secure/private-provenance-through-host-migration lane at exact current main 633c75be26001d5a4ef6e04c7696e8246713be44; main was rechecked immediately before artifact finalization and remained unchanged. DISPOSITION=FAIL/BLOCKING_INTEGRATION_CONTRACT_GAP for pixel-backed Gen7 host migration as currently modeled; this is NOT a claim that the pure Gen7 core leaks pixels and NOT a physical Fold7 leak observation. SOURCE: Primary Gen7 Fold7HostMigrationLeaseGen7 Snapshot/stage/decision and Fold7PresentationReceiptLedgerGen7 HostIdentity/Receipt carry exact attempt/host/readiness identity but no privacyEpoch, foregroundRevision, secure/private provenance, content context, or pixel lease. Migration may retire outgoing on FIRST_USEFUL or degraded timeout without a privacy authorization proof. Current main DisplayMirrorHost frozen path consumes a FrameLease lacking foreground/privacy context and explicitly falls back to live IWindowManager.mirrorDisplay when frozen capture is unavailable, including secure-content/capture failure; the mirror API carries no DuoOpen privacy provenance. Current main DuoShellService.capture reads containsSecureLayers() but then still calls asBitmap() and copies the frame before ShizukuBridge later discards secure=true, proving secure-bearing capture results reach readable bitmap materialization before app-side rejection; this does not prove protected pixels survive platform redaction. SnapshotCache remains keyed by panel only and Fold7ContinuityFrameStore leases still omit user/profile/package/task/window/privacy revision. PLATFORM_SOURCE: AOSP mirrorDisplay is a READ_FRAME_BUFFER SurfaceControl.mirrorSurface operation; AOSP secure-surface protections are defense-in-depth but do not supply DuoOpen's PRIVATE_FROST provenance policy. MODEL: proposed exact-current ContentProvenance + HostPresentationGrant contract PASS. Deterministic cases reproduce current privacy-independent ready-retire and timeout-retire; proposed model rejects stale public callbacks, revokes public grants on privacy/context revision, keeps PRIVATE/UNKNOWN monotonic within an attempt, and allows fresh PUBLIC on a later attempt. 100000 adversarial iterations: current privacy-mismatch readiness retire 100000/100000 by construction; proposed stale-event accepts 0; old pixel leases still authorized 0; PRIVATE/UNKNOWN pixel grants 0; fresh next-attempt PUBLIC grants 100000/100000. Counts test invariants, not real-world probabilities. REQUIRED CORRECTION: keep PresentationHinge visual-only; add attempt/generation/privacyEpoch/foregroundRevision-bound ContentProvenance and HostPresentationGrant; bind pixel leases to exact context; validate privacy grant at host staging and readiness consumption; short-circuit secure capture before HardwareBuffer/asBitmap/copy/cache/publication; privacy-gate and revoke live mirror; degraded timeout must fail closed to procedural PRIVATE_FROST/opaque or native path rather than create content authorization from elapsed time. CI=NOT_RUN; FIELD=NOT_RUN; production Git write=NO. Recommend Manager classify BLOCKED/NEEDS_IMPLEMENTATION+FIELD_SECURITY_GATE, preserve Primary identity/readiness primitives, and require public + FLAG_SECURE + work-profile + unknown-startup + public/private switch Fold7 migration testing before security acceptance. Startup AgentBus Beta-directive integrity drift was separately persisted and is not used as lane authority.
